# Selke Pest Control

> Selke Pest Control is a family-owned pest control company based in Mooresville, North Carolina, serving Lake Norman and the Charlotte Metro area.

Selke Pest Control provides general household pest control, mosquito control, flea and tick control, ant control, cockroach control, spider control, stinging-insect control, and mice and rodent control. Service is backed by a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Same-day service is available.

## Primary facts

- Business: Selke Pest Control
- License: North Carolina pest control license 2215P
- Reviews: 75+ five-star Google reviews
- Ownership: Family-owned and locally operated, 15+ years of experience
- Based in: Mooresville, North Carolina
- Service region: Lake Norman and Charlotte Metro (Mecklenburg County, Iredell County, Cabarrus County, Rowan County, Lincoln County, Catawba County, Union County)

## Service approach

Selke Pest Control's current average residential service takes more than 56 minutes. The exterior process can include six deliberate passes: dewebbing eaves and window frames, exterior liquid treatment, treatment of appropriate soil and landscape harborage, a perimeter granular band, targeted crack-and-crevice or crawl-space dust where appropriate, and a final inspection. Garage service and customer-requested interior treatment add further coverage. Compared with an 18-minute service-time benchmark, 56 minutes is about 211% longer (approximately 3.1 times as long). Treatment details vary by property, conditions, service plan, and product label.
